title: A Mysterious Spring Beetle
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Takagi, Sato, Detective Boys) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old cases/ file's culprit (s3 = Takashi Ishida) matches the transcript -- no reversal here -- but the old file was thin: it had no Ninomiya node (the alibi witness Shirai manipulated), no red-herring beat (Conan first floats Haruna as the murderer to test the Detective Boys, then retracts it), generic 'knows' edges instead of the real mechanism, and missed the two core forensic tricks (Shirai's frog-in-a-bottle phone alibi, and Ishida's use of the truck's climate control to fake a colder/earlier time of death). Those are reconstructed here from the transcript. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Strap marks on Shirai's neck match the marks left on the back of Ishida's own neck -- the same strap injured both men during the struggle.
Body temperature had dropped far faster than the normal ~1C/hour rate for the stated 9-10PM time of death, revealing the corpse had been kept somewhere colder before being moved.
The lidless bottle found in Shirai's pocket is missing its lid; a matching lid turned up in the delivery truck, tying the truck to the body.
Humus found in the truck matches soil used for cultivating beetle larvae, and the same humus was stuck in Shirai's hair -- placing his body inside the truck.

edges.method: strangled with a broken cellphone strap during a quarrel over the resale money
used the truck's climate-control unit to chill the corpse faster than normal, faking an earlier time of death

edges.motive_type: revenge_for_beetle_theft (red herring, floated by Conan then retracted)
